column1: # HAND-maintained translation rules. This is where the generated dictionary
# (translation-dictionary.tsv) speaks up when it cannot decide on its own. Every
# row is a deliberate decision; write the reason in the "note" column.
#   context    bare (no `.` before it: sil()) | member (a `.` before it: resim.sil()) | * | Receiver. (only a member of that receiver: Resim.)
#   target     the name to translate to; if "-", "do not translate this name"; if "^name", the receiver and the dot are swallowed too (Resim.dizi -> picStack)
#              "name(2,1)" reorders the arguments; if an entry is "'constant", that argument is written as a constant
#              (math.pow(1,'2) = first argument, then 2) -- the only way when the wrapper adds an argument
# A rule OVERRIDES the most frequent candidate of the generated dictionary. A row
# that matches the context exactly is looked up first, then the "*" row.
